title: Orange-Glazed {p} with {v}
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly oil a baking dish and set the {p} in the middle.
Rub the {p} with half the {spice}, salt and pepper, then spread the {sauce} over the top.
Toss the {v} and the {s}, cut into 2-inch chunks, with a little oil and the rest of the seasoning, and arrange around the {p}.
Bake uncovered 40 to 60 minutes, depending on size, until {doneness} and the vegetables are tender.
Rest the {p} 5 to 10 minutes, then carve and serve with the vegetables.
tip: A sugar-free marmalade gives the glaze with far less sugar, and the vegetables roast in the same dish.
